PROSPECTUS. Coralline Therapeutics, Inc. is offering 8,000,000 shares of common stock.

Management

Dr. Priya Ellsworth-Nakamura has served as our Chief Scientific Officer since 2021. Prior to joining us she led discovery research at Meridian Biologics. She received a Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering from the University of Southern California in 2009 and a B.S. in Chemistry from Reed College.

Tomasz Wiercinski-Bell has served as our Chief Financial Officer since 2022. He holds an M.B.A. from the Wharton School.

Our principal executive offices are located in San Diego, California.
